description: Blocks, passes or manufactures repeated controller messages on three vMIDI streams at once

params.text: Sets what happens to a controller that repeats a value it has already sent: OFF drops it, ON lets it through, GEN passes it and then resends the last value of every controller twice a second

inputs.text: One of the three vMIDI streams; only its controller messages reach the output of the same number

outputs.text: Carries the controller messages from the input of the same number, after the MODE setting has been applied

notes: only controller messages pass; notes, clock and everything else arriving are dropped
channel numbers are ignored, so controller 7 on channel 1 and controller 7 on channel 10 count as the same controller
at OFF the block on a repeated value lapses 2 seconds after the last message carrying it, so a control left alone and then nudged sends again
the three streams are processed separately but share one MODE setting
